familywise_size_RULE_5.definition: P(at least one of the 17 REPORTED cells fires) under the EXACT binomial null used to calibrate.
familywise_size_RULE_5.binding_sentence: A set of per-k firings from the 17-cell report is a familywise-~1.0% observation, NOT a 0.27% one. Only the pre-specified k = m = 17 cell retains the 0.27% size. A single fired cell out of 17 happens about 1 run in 100 under the exact null, not 1 in 370.

MEASUREMENT.what: log2 Ahat_k on the space-(T) arm at PS-R3, T=1e7, against the frozen calibrated interval of AMD-EXP-HQC-982268-v3

MEASUREMENT.firing_rule: STRICT: fires on log2 Ahat_k < c_lo or > c_hi

CTRL_ORACLE_negative_cell_count_reconcil.resolution: The 11 cells at |log2 A_k| < 1e-12 are the independent-BY-CONSTRUCTION oracle configurations (A1, A2, B3) whose exact value is 0; three of them land at -1e-16 in floating point and a naive sign test counts them as negative. Excluding that exact-zero class gives 18, which reproduces the validator's recorded count exactly. The >1-bit count (12) matched on the naive test already. Both floors (>=5) are met either way.

shape_of_the_measured_curve.observation: log2 Ahat_k at low k tracks C(k,2) * log2 Ahat_2 closely, i.e. the low-order behaviour is what a PAIRWISE-dominated negative dependence would give, with a growing shortfall as k rises. THIS IS A DESCRIPTION OF THE MEASURED CURVE AND NOTHING MORE: no mechanism is claimed, no model is fitted, and nothing here is a statement about A17 or HQC.
